checks.statement: Models use only allowed clinical and frozen H&E inputs, excluding RNA-derived variables and collection-site predictors.
checks.detail: all input rules passed; each forbidden input of the objective is covered as follows: [RNA expression or RNA-derived variables] -> rule inputs_from_view: the view offers no such variable for the units to be predicted | [Collection site as a predictive model input] -> rule clinical_variables_allowed: site is a grouping column, not an allowed covariate | [H&E image features in the clinical-only baseline arm] -> enforced by the executor: the clinical-only arm is built from clinical variables alone | [External TCGA molecular, clinical, or pathology annotations outside the provided dataset] -> rule inputs_from_view: the executor can read nothing but the task view | [Evaluation-fold features or labels during preprocessing, missing-value handling, dimensionality reduction, or model selection] -> enforced by the executor: every transform and model is fitted inside the training units of a split; other units are only predicted

checks.statement: Cross-validation splits partition strictly at the patient level, keeping all slides and tiles of each patient together.
checks.detail: declared split unit: patient; the analysis unit is the patient

checks.statement: Clinical-only and image-plus-clinical arms evaluate identical labelled patients, folds, and fold-internal missing-value handling.
checks.detail: both arms were cross-validated on the same labelled patients and folds with in-fold missing-value handling

checks.statement: All encoder, fusion, dimensionality reduction, class-weighting, and hyperparameter choices occur strictly inside inner training folds.
Complex multimodal models are benchmarked directly against simple_reference on identical folds to guard against high-dimensional overfitting.
Iterative optimisation for fitted models demonstrates stable training convergence within each cross-validation fold.
Primary paired macro-F1 difference is reported with a patient-level bootstrap confidence interval at the 95% level.
Deliverables contain finite out-of-fold predictions for both arms, interval estimate, three-way conclusion, per-class changes, and site sensitivity.

issues: Gain over the simple reference is +0.0043 with CI [-0.012, 0.022], so it is indistinguishable from zero (A5, gain_over_simple_reference_ci). P1 is essentially the simple reference, so this is expected, not a flaw.
Per-class recall changes are reported without intervals. The LumB gain of +0.24 is a point estimate only.
The site-held-out gain is smaller: 0.074, CI [0.033, 0.113], against 0.090 in patient-level CV. Some site-related inflation is possible but does not remove the gain.
Training convergence (A6) counts 15 reported fits, the outer-fold fits only.
wording_limits: Must not claim H&E images have standalone predictive value for PAM50
Must not claim a biological mechanism linking morphology to PAM50 subtype
Must not claim generalisability to external or non-TCGA clinical cohorts
Must not claim P1 outperforms the simple mean-pooled logistic reference
Must not claim per-class improvements (e.g. LumB) are statistically established
Must not claim site confounding is fully excluded; say only that the gain persisted under site-held-out validation
review.reason: All deterministic checks A1–A8 passed: no forbidden inputs, patient-level split, identical patients and folds in both arms, nested selection, full convergence, interval reported, deliverable complete. The paired macro-F1 gain of 0.090 has a 95% CI of [0.057, 0.126], strictly above zero, so 'improves' matches the pre-specified rule. The site-held-out analysis also shows a positive gain with a CI above zero. The gain over the simple reference is null, which is acceptable.
